description.fun: Vulpix is born with a single white tail that splits as it grows, usually into six, and the tails grow hot as Evolution nears. It can shape floating wisps of fire that people sometimes mistake for ghosts, which fits the haunted places it's so often found near. Its name blends the Latin 'vulpes', fox, and 'six'.
description.guide: A small, red-brown Fire fox Pokémon, usually seen with six curled tails. It can create floating wisps of flame and has a fire inside its body that never goes out. It evolves into Ninetales with a Fire Stone, and its Alolan form is a snow-white Ice type.
description.tagline: A six-tailed fox that conjures ghostly wisps of fire

description.fun: Alola's Vulpix moved up into the snowy mountains to avoid other Pokémon and turned snow-white and Ice-type, with breath cold enough, at −50 °C, to freeze anything. Locals once called it Keokeo, for its white coat.

Legend says Ninetales is nine noble saints reborn as one, and it can live for 1,000 years on the energy in its nine tails. It understands human speech and is famously vengeful: grab one of its tails and it may lay a curse on you that lasts a thousand years. It's based on the kitsune, the magical fox of Japanese folklore.
description.guide: The evolution of Vulpix with a Fire Stone, a graceful fox Pokémon with golden-white fur and nine long tails. It is intelligent, can live for 1,000 years and is said to curse those who mistreat it. Its Alolan form is an Ice and Fairy type revered as a deity on Alola's Mount Lanakila.
description.tagline: A thousand-year fox with a thousand-year grudge

names.ja: アローラ キュウコン

description.fun: On Alola's snowy Mount Lanakila, held by some to be holy ground, Ninetales turned Ice and Fairy type and is revered as a deity. It guides lost people to safety, mostly to get them out of its territory, and freezes anyone who angers it solid.
